subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: Should interrupted subagent announce delivery turns be reconciled as non-running `killed` parent-topic sessions while completion announce handoffs are tool-free across CLI, embedded, and Codex native paths?
rationale: This is a deliberate session-state and tool-boundary behavior change; source review can show it is coherent, but only maintainers can accept the stored upgrade semantics and permanent no-tools invariant.

options.title: Accept after lint rerun
options.body: Rerun or clear `check-lint`, then land this state model and tool-free invariant as the intended recovery behavior.

options.title: Change the terminal state
options.body: If `killed` is not the desired persisted state for delivery-only aborts, update the reconciliation patch before merge.

options.title: Pause for a broader delivery design
options.body: If all inter-session delivery turns need one generic recovery model, pause this announce-specific PR for owner design first.

recommendation.title: Accept after lint rerun
recommendation.body: Rerun or clear `check-lint`, then land this state model and tool-free invariant as the intended recovery behavior.
